comparison.objective: Adjusts a wrench jaw snugly, loosens a nylon nut in the safe direction, and sets the wrench down; the candidate locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1570 requires thumbwheel adjustment, correct fixed-jaw loading, and a loosening pull; the candidate requires simultaneous driver and wrench countertorque on coupled fasteners.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1570 checks jaw play during pulls, no wrong-direction loading, at least 60° loosening, and tool release; the candidate checks angular setpoint retention and repeated function.
comparison.reason: Although both use a wrench on a nut, PR-1570 tests adjustable-wrench setup and safe loosening, not preservation of a screw setting while tightening a jam nut.
